_meta.description: Deterministic tool registry for Path A core execution. All tools must return W3C PROV-O compliant metadata.

tools.name: financial_statement_parser
tools.description: Deterministically extracts specific line items (e.g., EBITDA, Total Debt, Interest Expense) directly from indexed SEC EDGAR filings.

entity_ticker.description: The stock ticker or CIK of the target entity.

line_item.description: The exact XBRL tag or standardized financial metric to extract.

tools.name: model_alpha_client
tools.description: Queries Model Alpha for obligor Probability of Default (PD) calculation.

tools.name: model_beta_client
tools.description: Queries Model Beta for obligor Probability of Default (PD) calculation.

tools.name: arbitration_calculator
tools.description: Computes weighted consensus Probability of Default (PD) arbitration between Model Alpha and Model Beta.

tools.name: divergence_validator
tools.description: Evaluates the bidirectional divergence between two probabilistic models against the system threshold theta. Used by the Compliance Agent.

model_alpha_pd.description: The Probability of Default (PD) calculated by Model Alpha.

model_beta_pd.description: The Probability of Default (PD) calculated by Model Beta.

threshold_theta.description: The maximum allowable divergence threshold before triggering HITL review.

tools.name: covenant_headroom_calculator
tools.description: Executes stateless jsonLogic to calculate Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (FCCR) and leverage headroom based on current financials.

covenant_ruleset_id.description: The Qdrant UUID pointing to the parsed credit agreement jsonLogic.

tools.name: mcp_evaluate_pdil_gatekeeper
tools.description: Evaluates a probabilistic inference payload against PDIL gatekeeper rules and W3C PROV-O provenance constraints.

inference_output.description: The inference output dictionary containing data and provenance_trace.

rules.description: Optional jsonLogic ruleset constraint for rule-based validation.

tools.name: mcp_score_t_plus_1_decision
tools.description: Evaluates state trace fidelity and T+1 forward decision quality using the Multi-State Reasoning Evaluator.

predicted_trace.description: Ordered sequence of executed state steps.

confidences.description: Optional confidence scores per decision step.

accuracies.description: Optional binary accuracy scores per decision step.

tools.name: audit_logger
tools.description: Logs compliance audit trails and capital buffer allocations.

tools.name: prov_o_audit_logger
tools.description: Commits a cryptographic hash and reasoning lineage to the Temporal state before final node execution.

tools.name: eve_v2_underwriting_engine
tools.description: Executes the full EVE v2.0 Institutional Single-Name Underwriting Engine pipeline across 5 valuation clocks, 3 independent engines, Challenger disagreement map, 2LoD Adversarial red-team transmission chains, and multi-engine corridor convergence.

tools.name: run_quantum_simulation
tools.description: Runs a Quantum Monte Carlo simulation to estimate credit risk (Merton Model).

tools.name: generate_market_scenarios
tools.description: Generates synthetic market scenarios using the Generative Risk Engine (GAN).

tools.name: analyze_snc_credit
tools.description: Performs a Shared National Credit (SNC) rating analysis.

tools.name: analyze_covenants
tools.description: Analyzes risk of covenant breach.

tools.name: compare_peers
tools.description: Compares company valuation multiples against peers.

tools.name: plan_workflow
tools.description: Generates a Neuro-Symbolic Plan (Graph Traversal) from start concept to target concept.

tools.name: ingest_file
tools.description: Ingests a file into the Gold Standard knowledge base.

tools.name: retrieve_market_data
tools.description: Retrieves real-time market data for a ticker.

tools.name: execute_python_sandbox
tools.description: Executes Python code in a secure, isolated sandbox.

tools.name: jules_remote_session
tools.description: Manages and dispatches remote coding sessions via the @google/jules CLI for the Architect Agent (architect_jules) with W3C PROV-O telemetry.

session_prompt.description: Task description passed to --session for remote new.

session_id.description: Session ID passed to --session for remote pull.

parallel.description: Number of parallel remote sessions to launch.
